claim: OPS-02 (scenario walk 2026-10-07; ADR 0292 applied): RecommendationActionsService.readDispositions no longer selects recommendation_actions unranged. It reads through readActionRows, which calls readWholeWindow (keyset pages on id, count exact, WholeReadError on a short or failed read), and its catch answers readable: false, so a book past PostgREST max_rows is read whole or said unreadable, never an arbitrary 1000 rows under readable: true. Pinned by recommendation-suppression.spec.ts, OPS-02 block (a 1,500-row book with a dismissal at row 1,400; a failing page 2). Comments are stripped before matching.

OPS-02: RecommendationActionsService.listByStatus (the Dismissed / Snoozed / Done leaves) reads every row of the leaf through readActionRows (readWholeWindow) and sorts newest-first after the read; it no longer issues its own unranged recommendation_actions select, which stopped at the newest 1000. A refused read throws WholeReadError rather than listing part of the leaf. Pinned by recommendation-suppression.spec.ts, OPS-02 block (1,200 dismissed rows listed in full, newest first; a failing page rejects). Comments are stripped before matching.
